The '''Infantry Support Platform''', abbreviated to '''ISP''' and also known as the '''clone swamp speeder''', was a [[Grand Army of the Republic|military]] [[landspeeder]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], a war between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] from [[22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY]]. Due to the vehicle's powerful and unique [[turbofan]] and [[Repulsorlift|repulsors]], it was highly maneuverable even in difficult terrain. The speeder was equipped with two forward-terrain [[laser scanner]]s and two twin swiveling [[blaster cannon]]s but could be modified to carry twin [[Beam cannon turret|beam cannons]] or [[Multi-Missile Pod]]s. It first saw action during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]] of 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Shortly after in the same [[Standard year|year]], the ISP was deployed during the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)|Battle on Felucia]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army]] as well as during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TwinMissilePods-SWL.png|thumb|left|260px|The ISP could be modified with a variety of front-mounted weapons.]]
The Infantry Support Platform, abbreviated to ISP and referred to as the [[Cloning|clone]] [[swamp]] [[speeder]] or simply swamp speeder,<ref name="VE" /> was a light [[landspeeder]] developed by [[Aratech Repulsor Company]] and produced by [[Uulshos Manufacturing]].<ref name="CV NEW" /> It was built from the foundation of a standard [[BARC speeder]],<ref name="Starfighters" /> a speeder bike<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> that was considered a lighter variant of the ISP.<ref name="HC 37">{{HelmetCollectionCite|37|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> As such, and because of its powerful and unique [[turbofan]] and [[Repulsorlift|repulsors]], it was highly maneuverable<ref name="CV NEW" /> and able to easily operate on most terrain quickly and smoothly, making the speeder convenient for a range of combat situations.<ref name="Starfighters" />

[[File:TwinBlasterCannons-SWL.png|thumb|right|260px|An ISP fires its double twin blaster cannons on Kashyyyk.]]
The speeder could attain speeds of 100 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] (sixty-two [[Mile per hour|miles per hour]]), had a length of five [[meter]]s (16 [[Foot|feet]] 5 inches), and was equipped with two frontal twin swiveling [[blaster cannon]]s, which were capable of immobilizing larger vehicles<ref name="Starfighters" /> with its blue bolts.<ref name="Blaster Cannons">{{Legion|set=Infantry Support Platform Unit Expansion|cardname=Twin Blaster Cannons}}</ref> The [[cannon]]s could be swapped out for twin swiveling [[beam cannon turret]]s<ref name="Beam Cannons" /> or twin swiveling [[Multi-Missile Pod]]s.<ref name="Missile Pods" /> Each of the two ISP [[pilot]]s could either individually control each weapon or link them together for larger targets, and the armaments could fire significantly over the speeder's weight.<ref name="Legion" /> Between the weaponry was a [[blaster]] pre-charge [[capacitor]]. The ISP also had a forward-terrain [[laser scanner]] on both sides as well as two mudshields on the front.<ref name="CV NEW" />

The unique turbofan produced less noise than most [[Ion engine|ion thrusters]] and could be reversed to provide a sudden stop. Two pilots sat toward the rear beside the craft's central repulsorlift, directly above which was the turbofan. Like most of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s vehicles, the speeder was mostly [[Color|gray]] with red accents,<ref name="CV NEW" /> although the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[442nd Siege Battalion]], who wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] equipped with green accents, used ISPs that were also given green markings.<ref name="Hasbro Clone Trooper">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Black Series|packtype=Entertainment Earth Exclusive 4-Pack|pack=Clone Troopers|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Clone-Trooper-Four-Pack-Black-Series-Entertainment-Earth.asp}}</ref>

==Role==
The ISP could travel through most terrain and was originally designed for [[Scout|patrolling]] swamps. The ISP's weapons allowed it to combat larger enemy vehicles<ref name="Starfighters" /> like [[Deflector shield|shielded]] [[gunship]]s and [[Starfighter|fighters]],<ref name="CV NEW" /> allowing the speeder to effectively support [[infantry]] units,<ref name="Starfighters" /> especially those under direct threat.<ref name="HC 27">{{HelmetCollectionCite|27|Databank A-Z}}</ref> The speeders were especially strong when fighting against the [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcer]], a [[droid tank]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CV NEW" />

==History==
[[File:EpisodeIII-ISPsonFelucia.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Two ISPs between an AT-TE and an AT-OT]]
The ISPs were utilized by the Galactic Republic toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Episode III" /> a [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-wide war waged between [[22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY]]<ref name="GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> against the Separatist Alliance.<ref name="Episode III" /> The ISPs were first used during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]]<ref name="HC 37" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="GA" /> where they earned the nickname "swamp speeder" from the Republic's [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s.<ref name="HC 37" /> Over its service in the war, the ISP was deployed into conflict in swampy locations and found its primary use in supporting Republic infantry.<ref name="Shin100">[[Shin Sutā Wōzu No Norimono 100|''Shin Sutā Wōzu No Norimono'' 100]]</ref> On the [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], the ISPs were used in conjunction with [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut]]s, [[All Terrain Attack Pod|AT-AP]] [[walker]]s, [[clone scout trooper]]s, and [[Wookiee warrior]]s against the [[Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Episode III" /> They served as an equivalent of the [[Wookiee]]s' [[Oevvaor jet catamaran|Oevvaor Jet Catamarans]] and [[Raddaugh Gnasp fluttercraft]]s.<ref name="CV NEW" />

In that same [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="GA" /> Infantry Support Platforms were also utilized by the [[327th Star Corps]]<ref name="327th">{{Legion|set=Infantry Support Platform Unit Expansion|cardname=327th Star Corps Elite Armor Pilots}}</ref> in the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)|Battle of Felucia]] as part of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]], where they escorted AT-APs, [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer|AT-TEs]], and [[All Terrain Open Transport|AT-OTs]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in search for any signs of [[droid]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" /> Under the direction of [[Commander]] [[Verd]], they also found use in the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] during the last [[Standard day|days]] of the Clone Wars, where they were used by the 442nd Siege Battalion alongside [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport|AT-RTs]] to besiege a [[Separatist base (Tarko-se)|Separatist base]] in [[Tarko-se]], a [[city]] on the planet [[Cato Neimoidia]] where the Separatists housed their forces in an [[Tarko-se arena|arena]].<ref name="BTCTG">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ISPSpeederSketch.jpg|thumb|right|270px|A sketch of the ISP by T.J. Frame for ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]
Infantry Support Platforms first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode III" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS date">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-revenge-of-the-sith-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Revenge of the Sith'' Original Reviews}}</ref> Later, on [[July 20]] of that year,<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050712.html|text=Top 20 EU Moments in ''Star Wars Insider'' #83}}</ref> the vehicles were identified in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity as Infantry Support Platforms in the article "[[Ground Assault: The Vehicles of Episode III|Ground Assault]]" from the [[Star Wars Insider 83|eighty-third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine. The article also introduced "ISP" and "swamp speeder" as alternative names for the vehicle.<ref name="Insider 83">{{InsiderCite|83|Ground Assault: The Vehicles of Episode III}}</ref> The speeder was first identified in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] as the swamp speeder in the ''[[Star Wars Expert Guide]]'' in [[2016]],<ref name="Expert Guide">''[[Star Wars Expert Guide]]''</ref> while the ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' "Clone Troopers" pack, released by [[Hasbro]] through Entertainment Earth in late 2016, brought the abbreviation "ISP" back into canon.<ref name="Hasbro Clone Trooper" /> The [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' introduced the names "clone swamp speeder" and "Infantry Support Platform" into canon as well.<ref name="VE" />

Infantry Support Platforms also appeared in the non-canon comic story "[[The Special Suits]]," set in the [[Imperial Era]]. The story was published in the [[LEGO Star Wars 111|111th issue]] of the [[LEGO Star Wars (magazine)|''LEGO Star Wars'' magazine]], written by [[Martin Fisher]], illustrated by [[Natascha Römer]],<ref name="LSW Magazine">{{LSWCite|111|The Special Suits}} {{Flash}}</ref> and released on [[July 12]], [[2024]].<ref name="jedi-bibliothek">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/datenbank/ausgabe/lego-star-wars-magazin-111|text=LEGO Star Wars Magazin 111|archivedate=20240303173302}}</ref>

The vehicle was developed by concept artist [[T.J. Frame]] when he first joined the Episode III Art Department. At first, he came up with a ''Star Wars''–style swamp boat, which was inspired by real [[Wikipedia:Airboat|fanboats]].<ref name="Old DB">{{DB|vehicle|swampspeeder|swamp speeder}}</ref> The aforementioned ''Star Wars Insider'' article also described the ISPs as a futuristic reinterpretation of the real airboats used to cross marshes throughout the [[Wikipedia:Southeastern United States|American Southeast]].<ref name="Insider 83" />
